<thought>Use a complete, valid CIF for bulk silicon (diamond structure) with symmetry operations and occupancy, then call enumerate_slabs_text to generate all (111) slab terminations. Save the resulting JSON to a file and return its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
<action_input>{
  "bulk_cif": "data_Si
_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M   'Fd-3m'
_symmetry_Int_Tables_number   227
_cell_length_a   5.431
_cell_length_b   5.431
_cell_length_c   5.431
_cell_angle_alpha   90
_cell_angle_beta    90
_cell_angle_gamma   90
_chemical_formula_sum   'Si1'
_chemical_formula_structural   Si
loop_
 _symmetry_equiv_pos_as_xyz
  'x, y, z'
  '-x, -y, -z'
  'y, x, -z'
  '-y, -x, z'
  'z, -x, -y'
  '-z, x, y'
  '-x, -z, y'
  'x, z, -y'
  '-y, z, -x'
  'y, -z, x'
  '-z, -y, -x'
  'z, y, x'
loop_
 _atom_site_label
 _atom_site_type_symbol
 _atom_site_fract_x
 _atom_site_fract_y
 _atom_site_fract_z

}"}
